rights.edition_evidence_excerpt: Fifth Edition in One Volume. Methuen & Co. Ltd., 36 Essex Street W.C., London. New and Revised Edition October 1905. Reprinted April 1913.
rights.scope: Printed words in the supplied edition; no music, images, modern copyrighted versions or PG boilerplate imported.

counts.duplicates: Determined by integration across all ten collections and existing corpus.

extraction.faithfulness: Complete lyric stanzas; typographical indentation and stanza numbers removed. Original words, punctuation and printed chorus abbreviations retained. No length truncation or modernisation.
extraction.optional_stanzas: No108 retains all seven stanzas, including two source-bracketed optional stanzas. Only their four square-bracket delimiters are removed so existing readers do not misclassify the first sung lines as apparatus.
extraction.section_labels: 27 printed CHORUS:/CHORUS./Refrain labels across eight songs become typed chorus/refrain section metadata. Their labels are removed from sung text, all following lyric words retained. Ordinary lyric use of refrain in no85 is unchanged.

count_reconciliation: 121 numbered songs; no50 printed in two parts retained as one complete work. No58 has two musical settings with small verbal variants: first complete setting retained, second preserved as alternate_musical_setting in audit candidates. No25 editorial quotation excluded from lyric body.
original_language_review: All121 accompanying numbered notes preserved for audit. Non-English parallels mentioned in notes are not imported; the songs themselves are English folk lyrics or explicitly English editorial recompositions, with no identified translation.
